# openrouter_workspace_members (Data Source)

WorkspaceMembers DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openrouter_workspace_members" "my_workspacemembers" {
  id = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The workspace ID (UUID) or slug

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of workspace members (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of members in the workspace

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the membership was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the workspace membership
- `role` (String) Role of the member in the workspace
- `user_id` (String) Clerk user ID of the member
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace
